_why: F39#3 round 2 (LANE-MESHY, 8 Nov 2026): judges on qj/F39-3-stack-v2 (3 of 3) said the stepped Drowned Garden terrace 'does not read as drowned' and has 'no water among the steps'. When enabled, scripts/world/water_garden_flood.gd lays one still, shallow water sheet (installed water.gdshader) on the flat 28.2-28.4 m crest the terrace stands on: surface_y with cells only where the sampled ground lies min_depth_m to max_depth_m below it, so it never spans a slope. Render only: no collider, water volume, swim/depth query, route, spawn or durable-state change. OFF until judged.
